title: randia euacantha
intro: Randia euacantha, commonly known as the "wild lime" or "wild orange", is a tropical plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Randia euacantha include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, potentially relieving pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which may help combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Randia euacantha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
